pages.title: 从对称性约束孤子谱
pages.text: 研究有质量间隙的二维费米体系。同一真空上的激发是粒子，不同真空间的插值是孤子；目标是用对称性限制它们如何组成多重态。

en.title: Symmetry constraints on soliton spectra
en.text: In a gapped two-dimensional fermionic theory, equal asymptotic vacua give particles; distinct vacua give solitons. The aim is to constrain their multiplets using symmetry.

pages.title: 拓扑缺陷线超越群对称
pages.text: 群对称的缺陷线可逆。临界 Ising 模型的对偶线融合后却分解为两项，因此需要用融合范畴描述；第二式是背景例子。

en.title: From groups to non-invertible lines
en.text: Group-like defect lines are invertible. The Ising duality line instead fuses into a direct sum. This background example motivates replacing a group by a fusion category.

pages.title: 交点空间带有奇偶分次
pages.text: 费米理论的线交点既可为偶也可为奇。只记录融合的总重数会丢失统计信息；超融合范畴分别保留两类交点及其符号。

en.title: Graded junction spaces
en.text: Junctions may be even or odd. Total fusion multiplicities alone lose the statistics. A superfusion category retains both components and their sign rules.

pages.title: 简单缺陷线的两种类型
pages.text: m 型线只有偶自同态；q 型线还携带奇自同态，对应线上 Majorana 自由度。这里自同态必须作为超代数理解，不能只比较普通维数。

en.title: m-type and q-type simple lines
en.text: An m-type line has only an even endomorphism. A q-type line also supports an odd Majorana mode. The endomorphism superalgebra, rather than ordinary dimension alone, distinguishes them.

pages.title: 真空形成超模范畴
pages.text: 对称范畴描述可作用的线，超模范畴描述真空及线对真空的作用。以下考虑非可逆对称性破缺、费米奇偶性仍保留的相。

en.title: Vacua as a supermodule category
en.text: The symmetry category describes the lines; its supermodule describes vacua and the action on them. The phases studied retain fermion parity while breaking other categorical symmetries.

en.text: The vertical lines record boundary vacua, the rung is a symmetry line, and the two junctions retain their parity. The ladder represents an operator between excitation sectors.

pages.title: 乘法与费米交换符号
pages.tex:
\begin{gathered}\mathcal A_{\bar a}\mathcal A_{\bar b}\subseteq\mathcal A_{\overline{a+b}}\\(x\otimes y)(z\otimes w)=(-1)^{|y||z|}xz\otimes yw\end{gathered}
\begin{gathered}(\mathcal A,\mu,\eta,\Delta,\epsilon,S,\dagger)\\\Delta(1)^2=\Delta(1),\qquad\Delta(1)\ne1\otimes1\ \text{in general}\end{gathered}
pages.text:
乘法由梯形图上下拼接，再用模范畴的结合变换化简。交换两个奇交点时出现负号；第二式说明所采用的超张量积约定。

余乘法组织多激发态，但只能拼接真空边界相容的扇区。单位的余乘法是相容性投影，通常不是整个张量积上的单位。

en.title: Multiplication and the Koszul sign
en.text:
Stack ladders vertically and reduce them with module associators. Exchanging odd junctions introduces a minus sign. The second equation records the super tensor-product convention.

The coproduct organizes multiple excitations while enforcing compatible intermediate vacua. Its value on the unit is a compatibility projector, generally not the identity on the full tensor product.

pages.title: 用本原幂等元分解表示
pages.tex:
\begin{gathered}e_i e_j=\delta_{ij}e_i,\qquad\sum_i e_i=1\\\mathcal A=\bigoplus_i\mathcal A e_i\end{gathered}
\begin{gathered}\mathcal R=\bigoplus_{i,j}\big(\mathcal R_{ij}^{\bar0}\oplus\mathcal R_{ij}^{\bar1}\big)\\i=j:\ \text{particles},\qquad i\ne j:\ \text{solitons}\end{gathered}
pages.text:
在半单情形，从相互正交的本原幂等元构造简单左模。需另行判断不同左理想是否同构，以及是否还要补入奇偶反转的表示。

箭图节点是真空，自环是粒子，连接不同节点的箭头是孤子。蓝色与红色区分偶、奇激发；同一不可约多重态中的态质量简并。

en.title: Primitive idempotents and representations
en.text:
Primitive orthogonal idempotents give simple left modules in the semisimple setting. Isomorphic summands must be identified, and parity-reversed representations need a separate check.

Nodes are vacua; loops denote particles and arrows between nodes denote solitons. Blue and red encode even and odd excitations. States in a single irreducible multiplet have equal mass.

pages.title: 费米 Fibonacci 例子
pages.text:
这里非平凡线为 m 型，但三线交点已经同时含偶、奇分量。它说明：线本身的类型与融合交点的奇偶维数是两层不同的数据。

这个例子的非平凡线为 q 型。它可由 Ising 融合范畴的费米凝聚得到，必须保留附着于线上的 Majorana 自由度。

en.title: The fermionic Fibonacci example
en.text:
The nontrivial line is m-type, yet its trivalent junction space has both parities. The type of a simple line and the grading of fusion junctions are distinct pieces of information.

Here the nontrivial line is q-type. Fermion condensation of the Ising fusion category produces this example, including the Majorana degree of freedom on the line.

en.text: Each orientation contains one even and one odd state, giving four states in total. The quiver records excitations between vacua, not classical trajectories.

pages.title: 二重超对称极小模型
pages.text:
以 A 型模型为起点，用 Landau–Ginzburg 超势描述其临界点。以下只研究保留超对称的最弱相关形变，并不把结论外推到任意形变。

固定形变的总体尺度，低阶项组成 Chebyshev 多项式。Dijkgraaf–Verlinde–Verlinde (1991) 给出相关背景；这个特殊超势使真空和质量可显式计算。

en.title: The N=2 minimal-model starting point
en.text:
Start with the A-series Landau–Ginzburg description. The following spectrum concerns the least relevant supersymmetry-preserving deformation, not an arbitrary perturbation.

Fix the overall deformation scale. The lower terms complete a Chebyshev polynomial, following Dijkgraaf–Verlinde–Verlinde (1991). This special form makes the vacua explicit.

pages.title: 相邻真空与共同质量
pages.text:
真空来自超势的临界点。此形变的稳定 BPS 孤子连接相邻真空；质量按所示超势归一化，改变总体尺度会同时改变所有质量。

形变算符在线作用下的本征值必须等于该线的量子维数。先在玻色化理论中筛选满足条件的线，再进行费米凝聚，得到保留的超融合范畴。

en.title: Adjacent vacua and a common mass
en.text:
Critical points determine the vacua. Stable BPS solitons in this deformation connect neighbours. The mass is normalized by the displayed superpotential; restoring the overall scale rescales every mass.

The perturbing operator must have line eigenvalue equal to the quantum dimension. Select such lines in the bosonized theory, then apply fermion condensation to obtain the surviving superfusion category.

pages.title: 保留融合规则中的奇偶性
pages.text:
重数沿用截断的 SU(2) 融合范围，交点奇偶性则由两个标签的乘积决定。这里固定轨道代表元；物理多重态不依赖这一选择。

超对称配对同一有向扇区内的偶、奇态；保留的非可逆对称性进一步联系不同扇区。两者合起来解释整个 A 型孤子链的简并。

en.title: Parity in the surviving fusion rule
en.text:
The range follows truncated SU(2) fusion, while the product of labels fixes junction parity. Fix orbit representatives; physical multiplets are independent of that choice.

Supersymmetry pairs even and odd states within an oriented sector. Non-invertible symmetry relates different sectors. Together they explain degeneracy along the A-type soliton chain.

en.title: Obtaining the D and E series
en.text: The relevant Frobenius algebra survives the least relevant deformation, so gauging remains compatible with it. Exceptional models use their own algebra objects and are not simply ordinary group quotients.

pages.title: 二重超对称的真空指标
pages.text: Witten 指标由超对称真空的奇偶差给出，并在这些保留超对称的形变下保持。这些二重超对称例子中，真空全部为玻色型。

en.title: Vacuum indices for N=2
en.text: The Witten index is the signed count of supersymmetric vacua and is preserved by these deformations. The N=2 examples here have bosonic vacua throughout.

pages.title: 单重超对称的不同起点
pages.text:
单重超对称模型使用实超场。其保留范畴中会同时出现 m 型与 q 型线，因此真空奇偶性、表示箭图和指标都不同于二重超对称情形。

取负耦合的有隙分支，临界点给出超对称真空。正耦合可触发无质量流，因此不能把两种符号下的红外结论混用。

en.title: The N=1 starting point
en.text:
Use a real superfield for the N=1 series. The surviving category contains both m-type and q-type lines, changing vacuum parity, representation quivers and indices.

Take the negative-coupling gapped branch. Critical points give supersymmetric vacua. Positive coupling can produce a massless flow, so the two infrared conclusions must be distinguished.

pages.title: 混合反常与半整数费米数
pages.tex:
\begin{gathered}\mathcal N=2,\ A_2:\quad L_1^2=\mathbb C^{0|1}L_0\\\langle\mathrm{sol}|e^{2\pi iF}|\mathrm{sol}\rangle=-1\quad\Longrightarrow\quad F\in\mathbb Z+\tfrac12\end{gathered}
\Delta Q_A=\frac1{2\pi}\operatorname{Im}\log\mathcal W''(\phi)\Big|_{\phi(-\infty)}^{\phi(+\infty)}
pages.text:
模结合变换记录破缺对称性与保留费米奇偶性的混合反常。局域于孤子扇区的作用给出半整数费米数；这不是改变整个体系的奇偶算符平方。

连续对称性计算给出独立解释：孤子两端的费米质量相位差决定诱导电荷的分数部分。沿用 Goldstone–Wilczek (1981) 的方法，并注意相位分支带来的整数差。

en.title: A mixed anomaly and fractional charge
en.text:
Module associators encode the mixed anomaly. Its localized action on a soliton sector forces half-integral fermion number. This does not change the square of the global parity operator.

A complementary calculation relates the fractional induced charge to the phase difference of the fermion mass at the two ends. It follows Goldstone–Wilczek (1981); branch choices can shift the integer part.

pages.title: 把孤子态变成边界算符
pages.text: 态与算符对应把粒子变成同一边界上的算符，把孤子变成改变边界条件的算符。表示问题因此可以转到边界拓扑场论中研究。

en.title: From soliton states to boundary operators
en.text: State-operator correspondence turns particles into operators on one boundary condition and solitons into boundary-changing operators. This gives a topological route to the representation problem.

pages.title: 边界 SymTFT 的三面结构
pages.text: 对称边界保存范畴数据，物理边界承载动力学，侧边界上的线表示边界激发。两处交角连接这些描述；右图用截面表示体理论与边界之间的关系。

en.title: Three boundaries in SymTFT
en.text: The symmetry boundary stores categorical data, the physical boundary stores dynamics, and side-boundary lines represent boundary excitations. The section shows the relation between the bulk and its boundaries.

pages.title: 保留红外的费米统计
pages.text: 很重的中性费米子在低能中退耦，但统计信息不能丢失。费米单位线保存这层数据，并帮助边界构造补全正则表示分解中遗漏的奇偶反转表示。

en.title: Retaining fermionic statistics in the infrared
en.text: A heavy neutral fermion decouples dynamically but leaves statistics behind. The fermionic identity line retains this information and helps recover parity-shifted representations missed by a regular-module decomposition.

pages.title: 结果的适用范围
pages.text: 一般构造不要求超对称或可积性；这些模型提供了具体检验。它约束允许的多重态与简并，但单靠对称性不能决定所有态是否存在、绝对质量或完整散射矩阵。

en.title: What the construction determines
en.text: The construction does not require supersymmetry or integrability. It constrains allowed graded multiplets and degeneracies; symmetry alone does not fix their occurrence, absolute masses or the full scattering matrix.
